_about: Public-domain St John Fisher (1469-1535, Bishop of Rochester, martyr) in English for the Word Hoard: The English Works, ed. John E. B. Mayor (Early English Text Society, 1876), the Commentary on the Seven Penitential Psalms, ed. J. S. Phillimore (2 vols, 1914-1915), A Spiritual Consolation and Other Treatises, ed. D. O'Connor, and the Funeral Sermon of Margaret, Countess of Richmond, ed. J. Hymers (Cambridge, 1840), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 31 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

fisher-english-works: The English Works of John Fisher, Bishop of Rochester, Part I, ed. John E. B. Mayor (London: N. Trübner for the Early English Text Society, MDCCCLXXVI)

fisher-funeral-sermon-margaret: The Funeral Sermon of Margaret, Countess of Richmond and Derby, ed. J. Hymers (Cambridge: University Press, M.DCCC.XL)
